snippet.title: Shadows Launch Trailer | Halo Infinite
snippet.description:
The Falcon has landed 🦅

From the shadows emerges Operation: Shadows, the first of Halo Infinite’s 2025 Fall Update. ONI does not come empty handed and brings a suite of deliveries including the long-awaited Misriah Armory Falcon, the new Vestige Carbine, powerful Forge updates, Weapons Bench additions, and more!

Upgrade to the Premium Operation Pass for 50 tiers, 4 armor sets, bonus XP, an extra challenge slot, and instant unlocks.

Risk it all. Deny everything.

#OperationShadows runs through September 8.

Read all about it: https://aka.ms/ShadowsLaunch
